messages:
marta: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A re: reviews/promos/comp. Drop clarifying q's here and I’ll answer or link the canonical doc. :wave:

lee: Thanks! Two things: 1) Will promos always be effective the 1st of the month? 2) If we approve a retention off-cycle promo, how does retro pay work?

marta: Short: we try to align promos to the 1st for payroll simplicity. Off-cycle promos can be approved but payroll handles retro pay on a case-by-case basis; Finance signs off and HR runs a retro calc.

owen: For calibration packets, do managers need to call out parental leave / long-term sick explicitly? Concern about people returning mid-cycle.

marta: Yes 10 please include a short "leave context" block with dates and a 1-2 sentence note. Approved leave is excluded from negative scoring during calibration.

tasha: Can People Ops provide anonymized promotion rates by level for last cycle? Leadership requested it for a meeting.

marta: Yep 10 I will post a sanitized CSV (counts + pct by level, no PII) within 72 hours. If you need org-level splits say so.

tasha: Thanks. Also can we get the off-cycle packet template link here?

hr-bot: Off-cycle packet template posted: https://redwood.internal/hr/offcycle-packet (internal only).

marta: Scheduling a 30-min manager office hour tomorrow 16:00 PT to walk through packets and calibration tips. Zoom + calendar invite to follow in this thread. Drop any follow-ups here and I’ll consolidate.
